name: Yeshchyo odin raz
source:
Tens... Hundreds... Thousands of cycles. This is a story about a person who has once again ended up in that very same pioneer camp. About a person who no longer remembers how long he has been here. About a person who must live through this story one more time.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=654122400]Steam[/url]]
translation:
数十…数百…数千次循环。这是一个关于一个人再次进入同一个拓荒者营地的故事。关于一个不记得自己在这里呆了多久的人。关于一个必须再次经历这个故事的人。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=654122400]Steam[/url]]
